title: ShipMyCar Vehicle Logistics Quote Connector
description: UK/EU and international car transport quotes with HMRC, IVA, DVLA and logistics costings.
summary: UK/EU and international car transport quotes with HMRC, IVA, DVLA and logistics costings.
offersHint: UK/EU and international car transport quotes with HMRC, IVA, DVLA and logistics costings. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.shipmycar.co.uk/mcp

toolsPreview.name: quote_update_draft
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user provides or corrects ShipMyCar quote details. It returns a stateless draft plus next questions and does not create records, send email, or contact ShipMyCar.

toolsPreview.name: quote_get_requirements
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a ShipMyCar quote draft needs checking before generation. It only inspects the draft and returns route requirements, enabled services, missing fields, and next questions.

toolsPreview.name: quote_generate
toolsPreview.description: Use this after the user explicitly confirms a complete ShipMyCar quote draft. It calculates pricing, writes a private quote continuation/API usage record, and returns a continueQuoteUrl. It does not send email or create a public booking.
